question: The discussion paper titled '____' was released by NITI Aayog on 15 January 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Multidimensional Poverty in India since 2005-06**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National establishment for the reworking Republic of India, conjointly known as NITI Aayog, was fashioned via a resolution of the Union cupboard on Jan one, 2015.
 
• NITI Aayog is that the premier policy ‘Think Tank’ of the govt of the Republic of India, providing each directional and policy inputs. Whereas coming up with strategic and long-run policies and programs for the Govt of the Republic of India, NITI Aayog conjointly provides relevant technical recommendations to the Centre and States.
 
• NITI Aayog Chairperson: Narendra Modi.
 
• NITI Aayog Headquarter: New Delhi.
